subject: Commercial impact from delayed multimodel support — request for provisional concession
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@launchco.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: LaunchCo GTM Team <gtm@launchco.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Impact from delayed multimodel support — commercial ask

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the chat last week. To recap: our January 15 public launch for LaunchCo Search relies on Redwoods multimodel routing to stitch responses across embeddings + retrieval + a second reranker stage. Your engineering note indicated multimodel rollout is slipping ~3–5 weeks.

That delay creates two risks for us:
- A potential launch postponement (non-starter for our sales cadence) or
- Shipping with a simplified single-model flow that materially increases token costs and reduces relevance.

We'd like to explore a short-term commercial safeguard while your product team completes the multimodel work. Specifically: a provisional credit or temporary rate buffer covering the delta we expect in token spend for the first 3 months of GA. We estimate the incremental cost impact at ~$25k–$40k for Q1 usage.

Attached is a one-page impact summary and a quick table of scenarios (LaunchCo_Impact_Summary.xlsx). Can Redwood provide a provisional approach (one-time credit, short-term % discount, or capped overage) and an approximate timeline for an internal approval path? Wed like to confirm next steps by Dec 24 to keep our launch plan intact.

Appreciate you and your team moving quickly on this — Alex

[attachment: LaunchCo_Impact_Summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@launchco.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 12:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Impact from delayed multimodel support — commercial ask

Alex — thanks for the clear summary and for the spreadsheet. Ive reviewed it and agree the options you listed are the right framing.

Internal plan Im proposing (fast-track):
1) Provide a provisional, timeboxed concession: either a one-time onboarding credit or a 3-month capped overage (we should decide which is cleaner for accounting).
2) Credit size: engineering and finance need to give a recommended cap; my ballpark is $30k or 20% of expected Q1 Spend, whichever is lower.
3) Conditions: LaunchCo signs an MoU/MAP with delivery milestones and we confirm product ETA (were expecting a firm completion date from runtime team this week).

Im looping in Karthik (commercial lead) and Marissa (finance) for approval path and final numbers, and Jonas for SLA/ops impact. Marissa — attaching my calc so you can see the spreadsheet assumptions (provision_calc.csv). Could we aim to confirm exec approval by Dec 23?

Alex — if we can get signoff, Ill send a short credit note and a mutual action plan doc for signature.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

[attachment: provision_calc.csv (csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Impact from delayed multimodel support — commercial ask

Team,

Quick notes from product/commercial perspective:
- Were trying to balance revenue protection + the customer relationship. LaunchCo is a high-velocity SaaS launch and visible reference if the GA goes well.
- I prefer a one-time onboarding credit (clear accounting, yes/no decision) vs. a recurring % discount — simpler to sunset and communicate.

Requesting input:
- Marissa: recommended cap and GL treatment (one-off credit vs. recurring discount). If we do $30k as Stephanie suggested, what is the approver level?
- Jonas: confirm whether ops/support cost delta is operationally material or just token-cost. Any SLA implications we should record?

Id like to keep this narrow: one-off credit up to $30k contingent on MAP signatures and product ETA confirmation. If finance is comfortable, Ill sign the commercial approval and Stephanie can issue the credit note.

Karthik
Head of Commercials
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Dec 2026 14:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Impact from delayed multimodel support — commercial ask

Karthik / Steph — reviewed the numbers and LaunchCos ARR profile. Finance comfortable with a one-time credit approach under these conditions: 
- Maximum one-time credit: $30,000 (GL: COGS adjustment)
- Alternative: capped overage for 90 days not exceeding $30k in aggregate
- Conditions: MAP in Drive (link below) signed by both parties; product ETA confirmed by Engineering; credits applied to first invoice post-launch
- Approval path: Marissa (Finance) + Karthik (Commercial) = internal sign-off. For credits > $50k require VP Finance signoff (not needed here).

Ive added the MAP template to Drive for signatures and flagged accounting entries. If Commercial confirms the one-off credit, I will prepare the credit note and accounting entry.

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Related: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_MutualActionPlan

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@launchco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Dec 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: LaunchCo provisional credit — approval and next steps

Alex — good news: internal approval secured for a one-time, timeboxed commercial safeguard. Summary below and next steps.

What we approved
- One-time credit: $30,000 maximum (applies to first invoice after GA)
- Conditions: LaunchCo signs the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and confirms acceptance of the product ETA when provided by Engineering
- Accounting treatment: one-off credit (COGS adjustment) — prepared by Finance

Next steps / deliverables
1) LaunchCo to review & sign the MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD_MutualActionPlan
2) Redwood to issue credit note once MAP signed (Ill send credit_note_2026-12.pdf)
3) Engineering will confirm firm ETA in a follow-up by Dec 30

Well hold the credit in reserve until the MAP is countersigned. Please confirm youre comfortable with the approach and Ill route the credit note for signature.

Best,
Stephanie
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

[attachment: credit_note_2026-12.pdf (pdf)]
